catalog_seed_rules: U0 scans time in PTS order. U1 uses all hits from the frozen goal-template dimensions, timing anchors and a separately enumerable unknown channel. U2 adds frozen object and text-region entries, U3 adds frozen single-image geometry, U4 and U5 add both. No auto time-full route in U1-U5. For unnamed goals the existing old discoverability ordering supplies first words, followed by all recurring non-ubiquitous candidate terms. Per-frame comparison and root edges have no per-seed truncation.
graph_rules: Direct original comparison edges, an equivalent chain of same-root neighbors, and consecutive non-timing neighbors sharing a visual dimension inside a frozen time group. Computation window crossing is marked only on documented edges. External comparison endpoints remain gaps. U5 orders frontiers using provisional before/after/reference/gap slots, and opens additional conflict, comparison and sparse retrieved-time ranges. No verified identity or causation is inferred.
source_rules: All routes propose uncovered catalog intervals wider than twice the median positive coarse cadence. U5 also proposes gaps along its path, D5 neighborhoods and brackets for comparison endpoints missing from the library. An explicit between-samples request enables source review across the source duration in every route. Unions and splitting into transport chunks preserve all planned ranges. Sampled windows never imply all their source frames were seen.
termination: Routes exhaust only when enumerated entries and planned work have been consumed without fault. Overall automated answer remains goal_unresolved pending independent image judgement. Technical interrupt/elapsed watchdog produces incomplete_technical_abort and preserves unread tasks. No count cap on images, pages or windows. Full original video coverage is never implied by the archive or sampled windows.
evaluation: E0 and source/reference spans are evaluator-only. Pixel source receipt, PTS and exact sample checks are prerequisites for scoring. Frozen historical references and fresh anchors are separate from input prompts. Full-source claims are limited to reviewed frames/spans, unknown remains open. Semantics add no membership and carry no physical identity or absence claim.
